annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously states that servers must not include the Accept-Encoding header when a 415 response is issued for reasons unrelated to content codings, complementing the preceding clause that requires inclusion when the failure is due to unsupported content coding. No alternative reasonable interpretations or missing constraints are evident.
